description: Prespecified positive-route follow-through: COMPACT_LINEAR/LONG_SILU x ZERO/CROSS_RESP, all12 new scratch50. Loss objectives/weights and PAIR/ownEMA/oldgate unchanged. Fixedsource scientific criterion controls only pending seeds, never target score or healthy rows.

notes: Combination follow-through is separate from original unmodified relation matrix; same R/E tau=.2,alpha=.5,lambdaR/E=1,original entropy/gate/strong views; no new layer or lossweight search.
Existing temporal methods were identified on the exposed benchmark; this is a user-requested follow-through, not a newly blinded structural discovery.

First4 independently scratch50 source-only decisions before targetsummary; candidate health: finalLCE<=.5, Vmean decline<=1pp and worstRX<=2pp; R/E meaningful meanaux/Lgradient>=1e-5 and nonzero relationfraction>=.5.

Controls compute identical bank/diagnostics but have exactzero weighted auxiliary loss; newt1/t2/t3 settings and branch SiLU independent from mechanism factor. All other PA/frequency/reference/defaulthead preserved.
No headfit, no new branch classifiers, no U TX labels, no referencebank deployment, no Phase2.
Cudnn_deterministic=False retained from frozen parent recipe. Matching initial state does not prove exactly equal preU trajectories.
Sinc centered coordinate positive route kept independent; it is not stacked in this matrix.
